## Using this site

The content here is provided for information. Prices shown are indicative and do not constitute an offer until confirmed in a written quote.

## Quotes

A written quote is valid for thirty days from the date issued. Quotes are based on the inspection carried out on site.

## Warranty

Re-treats between scheduled visits are included while a protection plan is active. Termite warranties run for the term stated on your treatment certificate and may be renewed. Exclusion work carries a one-year guarantee. None covers new construction, alteration, or damage that existed before treatment.
